correctness.rationale: For every partition with \(2\le k\le N-1\), the orthogonal decomposition of \(\ell^2(\pi)\) supplies centered unit vectors \(a\in\operatorname{ran}(G)\) and \(b\in\ker(G)\). The perturbation \(P=\Pi+\varepsilon(u\otimes v)\) has positive entries for sufficiently small \(\varepsilon\), centered orthogonal factors, and hence is stationary and satisfies \(P^2=\Pi\). Compression gives \(Q=\Pi+(\varepsilon/2)(a\otimes a)\), whose nonzero orthogonal-projector mode persists at every finite power. Both endpoint partitions are handled by direct identities. Exact rational finite checks (13,899 assertions) independently verify formulas, not universal quantifiers.
